svg_folder_desc: Vault folder where drawing SVG files are saved
organize_by_note_desc: When on, SVGs are saved in a subfolder mirroring the note's path in the vault (e.g. "Projects/Book/Chapter 1"), instead of all together in the SVG folder. Prevents mixing drawings from notes that share the same title.
line_spacing_desc: Distance between the ruled lines on the writing area, in pixels (default 32). Smaller spacing fits more lines on screen, which helps on phones; write smaller to match. Applies to new handwriting blocks and empty ones; blocks that already contain writing keep the spacing they were written with.
bg_mode_desc: Background color of the drawing area. "Automatic" follows the Obsidian theme.
auto_scroll_desc: When the writing zone expands (pen near the bottom, or tapping the down-arrow button), automatically scroll down to follow it. Turn off if writing fast makes the zone snap away from your pen.
ocr_provider_desc: Which service performs the handwriting recognition.
gemini_key_desc: Required for handwriting OCR recognition. Get it from Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com).
openrouter_key_desc: Required when OpenRouter is the selected provider. Get it from openrouter.ai/keys.
openrouter_model_desc: Which OpenRouter model to use for OCR. Only models that can read images are shown -- click to browse and search (type "free" to find free ones).
error_gemini_key_missing: Gemini API key not configured — open the plugin settings
error_openrouter_key_missing: OpenRouter API key not configured — open the plugin settings
error_openrouter_model_missing: No OpenRouter model selected — open the plugin settings
ocr_langs_desc: Comma-separated BCP-47 language codes (e.g. "it, en, fr"). Used by the AI model for OCR.
wordlist_desc: Looks for a file named "handwriting-words.md" (one word or phrase per line) in the note's folder and every parent folder up to the vault root, and gives those words to the OCR as spelling hints -- useful for character names and invented words. Files at multiple levels are merged together (a vault-root list applies everywhere; a list in a story folder applies only to notes inside it). Keep lists short and focused: every word is sent with each request, so a long list adds cost and slows things down.
hyphen_breaks_desc: Joins words split across lines with a hyphen: "hand- writing" becomes "handwriting". Only a letter, hyphen, space and letter in a row is joined, so ordinary hyphens like "well-known" are left alone.
stay_on_note_name: Stay on current note after conversion
stay_on_note_desc: When a conversion finishes, do not switch to the note that received the text. Instead you stay wherever you are (for example writing the next handwritten note) and a notification tells you which note the text was added to.
debug_mode_desc: Show real-time notifications for IME/touch events (useful for diagnosing issues on Android).
keywords_summary: Keywords recognized by the OCR parser
keywords_desc: Write these keywords in your drawing to generate the corresponding markdown structure. All are case-insensitive (//h1 = //H1). Content follows the keyword separated by a space.
ui_language_desc: Language used in the settings page. "Automatic" follows the Obsidian system language.
btn_continuous: Continuous input mode (join lines into paragraphs, //Z for a paragraph break)
confirm_delete: Delete this handwriting block and the associated SVG file?
notice_placeholder_draw: Use the pencil button (top right) to draw
